passage:
reservoir — 水库；蓄水池
The town of Marlowe sits in a dry valley, and for sixty years its only water came from one underground reservoir.

committee — 委员会
Last spring the reservoir dropped to forty percent, and the town council created a committee of seven residents to decide how the remaining water should be shared.

proposal — 提议；方案
The first proposal came from Daniel, who runs a small farm on the eastern edge of town.

priority — 优先事项；优先权
Under the first, farms received priority; the town would keep its food supply but lose hotel income.

guaranteed — 有保证的
Under the third, households received a guaranteed minimum, and farms and hotels shared whatever remained.

scenarios — 情景；设想的情况
They built three simple scenarios.

recover — 恢复
Instead of asking whether the plan was fair, they asked how quickly the town could recover if the reservoir fell another ten percent.

satisfied — 满意的
Not everyone was satisfied.
